title: Documentary: 1922 - 1939
creator_credit: Sonya Freidman, Herman J. Engel and Texture Films
brief_description: Part one of a three part compilation history of the documentary film. This part presents films from 1922-1939. Each sequence offers an important example of documentary film style, content and construction. Before each of the documenatries represented, there is an introduction that places the film historically.
